features.quote: No mid-run intervention. Let it run.
features.justification_quote: If you tune task designs to maximize how often you trigger the degradation, you converge on tasks engineered to be maximally demoralizing rather than representative.

features.quote: Max turns: this is itself a variable. ... Run at two budgets (e.g. 15 and 40)
features.justification_quote: so you can see whether degradation is a function of "time spent failing."
